evidence.note: Risa reads the MoE router's expert-selection trace as a behavioral fingerprint of what a software agent is doing, using it to push sibling actions away from recently repeated computation during exploration and toward peer agreement once a patch is being written, then to arbitrate among completed attempts without an external judge or test execution.
evidence.title: Disagree to Explore, Agree to Commit: Routing-Guided Test-Time Scaling for Software Agents
